prompt: At the time of their publication, who was the editor of the magazine that published the two short stories that first developed the World Urslula LeGuinn would use for the first of the two books Harold Bloom would later call her masterpieces?
answer: The editor was **Cele Goldsmith**. She was editor of *Fantastic* in 1964, when Ursula K. Le Guin’s stories **“The Rule of Names”** and **“The Word of Unbinding”** were published there. These stories helped develop the world of **Earthsea**, the setting of *A Wizard of Earthsea*—one of the two Le Guin books Harold Bloom later called masterpieces.
